qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sub-scale European commercial truck and bus manufacturer competing against global heavyweights (Volvo, Daimler Truck, Traton). Lacks economic moat, scale advantages, or pricing power, evidenced by thin 3-5% EBIT margins and structurally sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC in the 3-6% range.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power). Sub-scale commercial vehicle and powertrain manufacturer with low single-digit operating margins (3-5%) and multi-cycle GAAP ROIC well below the 12% hurdle. Lacks meaningful scale or pricing power against larger peers Daimler Truck, Volvo, and Traton.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC has hovered between 2.6% and 8.7% since the 2022 demerger from CNH Industrial, averaging under 6%. EBIT margins of 3.7-5.8% reflect commoditized truck assembly economics and high cyclicality without the scale to fund transition capex profitably.
